svg.aria-label: The crash test: the watcher is stopped just before each of its 20 effects on one issue, and a fresh watcher, on the same machine or another, finishes it. 40 of 40 stops recover, with one post per command, one agent run per command or build, one pull request and one merge. Before #26, 14 of 30 stops broke the flow.
